exterior.mailboxNote: To our Aayushi — your whole circle is rooting for you as CA exam season comes around. We know how hard you've worked, and we have zero doubt you're going to do brilliantly. Rest when you need to, trust your prep, and know we're all in your corner. With so much love and belief, your friends & family.
